### The Totally Made Up Orchestra

![The Totally Made Up Orchestra](news/totally-made-up-orchestra.png)

Brian Irvine passionately believes orchestras are leaving too many people behind and that too many people in our communities feel orchestras are 'not for the likes of me' and have nothing in common with them and their lives.

Brian Irvine's "The Totally Made Up Orchestra" is in total contrast and a unique orchestra that blends composition, improvisation, words, sounds, movements, noises, gestures, humour and much head scratching into a unique and captivating performance.

### About Brian Irvine

Brian is an Ivor Novello award winning composer from Belfast. As Artistic Director of Dumbworld, he's at the vanguard of community-music making and composition in Ireland and the UK.

He has collaborated and made work with artists from vastly different disciplines including Seamus Heaney, Primal Scream, David Holmes, Joanna Macgregor, U2 and Jennifer Walshe, as well as thousands of groups and individuals from all dimensions of society including ex-paramilitaries, young offenders, victims of violence, special needs groups, residential homes, community choirs, gardeners, footballers, bankers, homeless associations, call centre workers and schools.

[Learn more about Brian Irvine](https://www.brianirvine.uk/)

[Learn more about Dumbworld](https://dumbworld.co.uk/)
